new_results.statement: For exact-rank-three A=R Lambda R^T whose nonzero spectral rows lie in K one-dimensional row directions, legitimate disjoint original-coordinate bank compression gives independent bank variables and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 C3 |det Lambda|^(-1/3) w_*^(-1/3) <= 2 C3 binom(K,3)^(1/3), where w_* is the largest bank-level squared Pluecker atom and C3=16 sqrt(30) 2^(1/4). For K=3 the bound is <209 independent of physical bank sizes.

For A_m=(J_m/m) direct_sum (J_m/m) direct_sum (-J_m/m), all m^3 nonzero physical Pluecker atoms have weight m^-3 and every local determinant theorem cost is C3 m, so Cauchy-Binet volume sampling and every positive moment of those sampled local costs diverge linearly in m although grouped-bank curvature is uniformly bounded.

unresolved_implication: Construct a source-valid approximate/grouped-bank transducer for generic many-direction spectral frames that preserves original-product provenance and controls the full residual quadratic interaction, or route the residual to a proved ridge/full-matrix-pair branch, before reciprocal physical-minor payment. Arbitrary additional spectrum remains unpaid.
